8 years ago, #BlackLivesMatter protesters had a protest in Grand Central for #MLKDay where they had signs with the names of various people who were killed by police.

So of course, cops showed up to interfere with & repress the protest.

NYPD Inspector James Palumbo is currently going through a mere departmental trial for stomping on a protester's head during a 2020 #BlackLivesMatter protest. At most, Palumbo can be fired as punishment but that's unlikely. https://t.co/KrsJLzZydQ
How long until Miami cops in this kind of cruiser are caught on video harassing & brutalizing Black people and/or arresting & repressing a #BlackLivesMatter protest?
